Sub: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for processing Joint Declarations for
member profile updation in EPFO-reg

Ref: 1. Head office circular no-WSU/2022/Rationalisation of work areas/Joint
Declaration/3638 dated 23.08.2023.

Please refer to subject cited above and circular under reference,

re In partial modification to the circular under reference, following documents have
been added in the list mentioned in Table-C of Annexure-I of the SOP under reference
for correction in Father/Mother’s name:

i. Aadhaar card of the member bearing the father/mother name

ii. | PAN card

ii. 10" or 12 school certificate/mark sheet bearing father/mother name
iv. Driving license

(This has approval of Competent Authority)

Copy to:

1. OSD to CPFC, FA and CAO, CVO, Director/ PDNASS for information please.
2. All ACC(HQ)s (Head Office) for information please.
3. All ACCs Head office for information please.

4. All RPFCs Head Office for information please.
5, IS division for necessary action please.
